The generic `/ws/rest/v1` resources that call `savePatientProgram` directly are three resource classes in `openmrs-module-webservices.rest`. Two more reach it indirectly through the core void/unvoid methods.

**Direct callers in the REST module**

1. `PatientStateResource1_8.save` adds a state to the parent program, then calls `savePatientProgram(parent)` (line 115). `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/resource/openmrs1_8/PatientStateResource1_8.java`, lines 111-117.
2. `PatientStateResource1_8.delete` voids the last state and calls `savePatientProgram(patientProgram)` (line 78). Same file, lines 70-83.
3. `ProgramEnrollmentResource1_8.save` returns `savePatientProgram(delegate)` (line 93). This is the `/programenrollment` create/update path. `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/resource/openmrs1_8/ProgramEnrollmentResource1_8.java`, lines 91-94.
4. `PatientProgramAttributeResource2_2.save` adds or keeps the attribute and calls `savePatientProgram(delegate.getPatientProgram())` (line 86). `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/resource/openmrs2_2/PatientProgramAttributeResource2_2.java`, lines 73-88.
5. `PatientProgramAttributeResource2_2.delete` soft-deletes the attribute and calls `savePatientProgram` (line 65). Same file, lines 60-66.

**Indirect callers through core void/unvoid**

6. `ProgramEnrollmentResource1_8.delete` calls `voidPatientProgram` (line 70), which the core implementation routes to `savePatientProgram`. `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/resource/openmrs1_8/ProgramEnrollmentResource1_8.java`, lines 64-71.
7. `ProgramEnrollmentResource1_8.undelete` calls `unvoidPatientProgram` (line 76), which also ends in `savePatientProgram`. Same file, lines 73-79.

**Core methods that relay the call (behaviour changes here propagate to 6 and 7)**

8. `ProgramWorkflowServiceImpl.voidPatientProgram` calls `savePatientProgram` (line 349). `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/impl/ProgramWorkflowServiceImpl.java`, lines 345-350.
9. `ProgramWorkflowServiceImpl.unvoidPatientProgram` calls `savePatientProgram` (line 368). Same file, lines 356-369.
10. `ProgramWorkflowServiceImpl.savePatientProgram` itself, the definition (line 248). It delegates to the DAO (line 282). Same file, lines 248-283. I did not confirm the closing brace, so the end line is approximate.

The core `PatientServiceImpl` also calls `savePatientProgram` (line 634), but that is core service code, not the REST module, so I left it out.

Items 1-7 are the REST resources that would be affected directly or through void/unvoid. Items 8-10 are the core relays and the definition.
